newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Assa Abloy says buys FAB stake.
newsitem.headline: Assa Abloy says buys FAB stake.

text.p: Swedish lock maker Assa Abloy said on Friday it had acquired 83 percent of FAB a.s. Rychnov nad Kreznou, the leading locks company in the Czech Republic.
"Through the acquisition of FAB...a good platform is created for Assa Abloy's continued organic expansion in the area," the company said in a statement.

"In the light of FAB's positive and stable profit margin and obvious growth potential the acquisition is expected to have a positive effect on earnings per share, to some extent already in 1997," Assa Abloy said.
FAB holds a 70 percent market share in the Czech Republic and has a strong position in Slovakia, the company said.
In 1996, FAB's sales amounted to 150 million crowns and its pre-tax profit was 25 million crowns. The company has around 1,000 employees.
